change: Workshop scan funnel from QR/URL to personal scan report PDF and portal next step.
root_cause: The existing selfscan and workshop pages were separate surfaces and did not produce the new visual six-domain report with radar, top opportunities, 90-day actions, workshop attribution and a direct portal conversion path.
prevention_rule: Workshop acquisition must remain one testable lineage: attributed URL -> consented scan -> deterministic six-domain scoring -> visible result -> downloadable report -> portal/pricing CTA. New workshop variants reuse this canonical flow rather than creating parallel forms.

historical_replay: Earlier workshop handout required a QR but had no canonical online destination that generated the intended report.
Existing zelfscan used a different 12-question model and did not provide the new six-domain workshop PDF design.
